name: claude-profile-switcher
description: Switch between Claude Code config directories (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) from a status bar item.

claudeProfileSwitcher.profiles.markdownDescription: Profiles to choose from. `configDir` is the value written to `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and **must be an absolute path** (the Claude Code extension ignores `~` and relative values). Leave `configDir` empty (`""`) for the built-in default (`~/.claude`).

label.description: Name shown in the picker and status bar.

configDir.description: Absolute path for CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or empty for the default.

claudeProfileSwitcher.autoDiscover.markdownDescription: Also list every `~/.claude-<name>` directory as a profile named `<name>`, in addition to `#claudeProfileSwitcher.profiles#`.

claudeProfileSwitcher.colors.markdownDescription: Status bar color per profile label, e.g. `{ "work": "#c62828" }`. While that profile is active the whole status bar is tinted via `#workbench.colorCustomizations#`. Use **Claude Code: Set Profile Color** to pick one.
